meta.title: Ping-Nord-Pong · The Campus Nord table tennis ranking

home.title: Campus Nord finally has a ranking.
home.lead: Log your matches, let your opponent confirm them and watch your ELO move. Public rivalries, challenges with chat and zero excuses.
home.note: this is where rivalries get settled ↑
home.tableAlt: Table tennis table with a ball bouncing between two paddles
home.emptyRankTitle: Nobody has stepped up to the table yet. Will you be the first?
home.emptyRankBody: Once there are confirmed matches, the top players will show up here.
home.weekBody: {crow} is the crow and {snake} the snake (the site drew lots). Whoever leads the head-to-head takes over the scene and wears their badge on the head; there are seven states, from a tie to total domination.

home.stepsTitle: From match to ELO in three bounces
home.step1Body: With whoever is at the table. If you want to arrange it first, challenge them from their profile and a chat opens, but you don't have to.
home.step2Body: One of you records it: to 5, 7, 11 or 21, one set or best of 3, 5 or 7, 1v1 or 2v2, with the points of every set.
home.step3Body: If the result is right they accept it and both ELOs move at once. If not, they reject it and it doesn't count.
home.rulesTitle: Was that serve legal? Check the rules.
home.rulesBody: The official rules in pocket size: serve, changes, doubles and the famous let.

rules.title: The rules, pocket edition
rules.lead: A summary of the ITTF rules so nobody argues about the serve.

official.p: Whoever reaches 11 points first with a two-point lead wins the set. At 10-10 play continues until someone is two ahead.
The ball is tossed up from the open palm and rises at least 16 cm.
The serve goes diagonally, from the right half to the right half, and players hit alternately.
If the serve touches the net and still lands in, the point is replayed.

house: Allowed formats: to 5, 7, 11 or 21 points; one set or best of 3, 5 or 7; in 1v1 or 2v2.
No match counts without the other side's confirmation. If nobody confirms within 48 hours, it expires.
Fair play: no made-up results and no matches arranged to inflate ELO.

legal.label: Legal
legal.draft: Draft written by the project. A person with legal knowledge should review it before the site opens to the public; this is not legal advice.
legal.prevails: In case of discrepancy between languages, the Spanish version prevails.

p: Ping-Nord-Pong is a student project, unofficial and not affiliated with UPC. It is free and we don't guarantee it will always be available.
Be at least 14 years old and have an email you can access. One account per person.
Don't log false results or arrange matches to inflate ELO.
Don't create multiple accounts, don't harass or insult in chat or in an alias, and don't impersonate others.
We may void matches, recompute ELO, change offensive aliases and limit or close accounts, always with a notice on the site and a way to appeal at {email}.
By using the service, your alias, ELO, statistics and confirmed matches are visible to anyone.
If the terms change we'll tell you on the site and ask you to accept the new version. Spanish law applies.
Your email (only for sign-in, never public), alias and avatar colour, ELO, matches, sets and dates, challenges and messages, reports and blocks, and language.
We don't store real name, photo, phone, location or third-party analytics. IP addresses only appear in providers' technical logs, with short retention.
Performance of the service you accept when signing up (account, ranking and matches) and legitimate interest in security and moderation.
Alias, ELO, statistics, confirmed matches and rivalries. Challenges and messages are only visible to the two people involved.
Supabase (database and sign-in, EU region) and Vercel (hosting). Any transfers outside the EEA rely on standard contractual clauses or the EU-US framework.
Chat messages: 90 days. Pending, rejected or expired matches: 30 days. Notices and rate-limit records: 30 days. Audit log: 1 year. Accounts inactive for 2 years are deleted automatically.

Access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability. You can download your data and delete your account in Settings, or write to {email}. You may also complain to the Spanish data authority (AEPD).
We only use necessary cookies: the session cookie (to keep you signed in) and the language preference.
We use no analytics or advertising cookies, which is why there is no consent banner. If analytics are ever added, they will be cookie-free, or we'll ask you with refusing as easy as accepting.
